8.3.3 StbM_GetCurrentTime
[SWS_StbM_00195] Definition of API function StbM_GetCurrentTime
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_00005, RS_TS_00006, RS_TS_00029, RS_TS_00030, RS_-
TS_00031, RS_TS_00014
⌈
Service Name
StbM_GetCurrentTime
Syntax
Std_ReturnType StbM_GetCurrentTime (
StbM_SynchronizedTimeBaseType timeBaseId,
StbM_TimeTupleType* timeTuple,
StbM_UserDataType* userData
)
Service ID [hex]
0x07
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
timeBaseId
time base reference
Parameters (inout)
None
timeTuple
Current time tuple that is valid at this time
Parameters (out)
userData
User data of the Time Base
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: successful
E_NOT_OK: failed
Description
Returns a time tuple (Local time, Global time and Timebase status) and user data details Note:
This API shall be called with locked interrupts / within an Exclusive Area to prevent interruption
(i.e., the risk that the time stamp is outdated on return of the function call).
Available via
StbM.h
⌋
[SWS_StbM_00196]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00386, SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If the switch StbMDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE, StbM_GetCurrentTime shall
report to DET the development error STBM_E_PARAM, if called with a parameter time-
BaseId, which is
• not configured or
• within the reserved value range.
